prompt.en: In which province is the story Anne of Green Gables set?
prompt.fr: Dans quelle province se déroule l'histoire d'« Anne… la maison aux pignons verts » (Anne of Green Gables)?

explanation.en: Lucy Maud Montgomery set her much-loved story on Prince Edward Island. It follows a young red-haired orphan girl.
explanation.fr: Lucy Maud Montgomery a situé son histoire bien-aimée à l'Île-du-Prince-Édouard. On y suit une jeune orpheline rousse.

source.quote: Anne of Green Gables, set in P.E.I. by Lucy Maud Montgomery, is a much-loved story about the adventures of a little red-headed orphan girl.
